title: Coral and the Thorn
author: C. M. Crane
blurb: Casper Ashgrove, an exiled storm-caller, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
